mapper.select: with T01 as ( -- Danh sách xuất kho ra MA select * from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'XPA' and A.date between date_format(#{dateRange[0]}, '%Y-%m-%d') and date_format(#{dateRange[1]}, '%Y-%m-%d') ), T02 as ( -- Danh sách đã nhận select * from pur_wh_records A where A.record_type = 'RNP' ), T03 as ( select T01.slip_no, T01.lot_no lot_no_request, T02.lot_no lot_no_receive from T01 left join T02 on T01.lot_no = T02.lot_no ), T04 as ( select T03.slip_no, count(T03.lot_no_request) total_lot_request, count(T03.lot_no_receive) total_lot_receive from T03 group by T03.slip_no ) select A.id, T04.slip_no request_no, T04.total_lot_request, T04.total_lot_receive, A.created_at, A.line, A.parent from T04 left join pur_wh_headers A on T04.slip_no = A.reg_no order by A.date desc

with T01 as ( -- Danh sách xuất kho ra MA select * from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'XPA' and A.slip_no = #{requestNo} ), T02 as ( -- Danh sách đã nhận select * from pur_wh_records A where A.record_type = 'RNP' ), T03 as ( select T02.id, T01.parent, T01.model, A.lot_group, T01.lot_no, ABS(T01.qty) qty, T02.req_no, T01.wh_user_code, T02.lot_no lot_no_receive, T02.created_at, T02.date, T02.receiver from T01 left join T02 on T01.lot_no = T02.lot_no left join lots A on T01.lot_no = A.lot_no ) select T03.id, T03.model, T03.lot_group, T03.lot_no,T03.lot_no_receive, T03.qty, T03.date, T03.receiver, T03.created_at, T03.req_no, case when T03.receiver is null then 0 when T03.receiver = "" then 0 else 1 end status, case when T03.receiver is null then 'Not yet' when T03.receiver = "" then 'Not yet' else 'Received' end status_name from T03;
